installation.note: groupdel is a core admin command available on all Linux systems

overview.summary: groupdel removes a group from /etc/group. The group must have no members (or only primary members); remove users from the group first with gpasswd or usermod if necessary.
when_to_use: Remove a group that is no longer needed
Clean up after removing all members
Delete a project or team group

syntax.description: GROUPNAME is required. The group must be empty (no members) on most systems.

examples.title: Delete a group
examples.use_case: When the group is no longer needed

common_pitfalls.description: groupdel may fail if the group has members (primary or supplementary).
common_pitfalls.solution: Remove users from the group first (gpasswd -d user group or usermod), or check your distro's behavior.

related_commands.description: Create a group; groupdel removes it
Remove a user from a group before deleting the group
